什么.pinyin: Wǒ shén me dōu bù xiǎng hē
什么.en: I don't want anything to drink.

什么.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài míng bai tā shuō shén me
什么.en: I don't quite understand what he says.
什么.es: No entiendo muy bien lo que dice.

什么.zh: 这样做的话什么都不会改变的。
什么.pinyin: Zhè yàng zuò de huà shén me dōu bù huì gǎi biàn de
什么.es: Eso no va a cambiar nada.

什么.zh: 告诉我你对湘南做了什么。
什么.pinyin: Gào su wǒ nǐ duì xiāng nán zuò le shén me
什么.en: Tell me what you did to Shounan.
什么.es: Dime qué le has hecho a Shounan.

坐.zh: 坐在我旁边的男人跟我说话了。
坐.pinyin: Zuò zài wǒ páng biān de nán rén gēn wǒ shuō huà le
坐.en: The man sitting next to me spoke to me.
坐.es: Me habló el hombre que estaba sentado a mi lado.

坐.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài tā páng biān
Wǒ xiǎng zuò zài wú yān qū
坐.en: I would like to sit in the non-smoking section.
坐.es: Póngame en la sección de no fumar, por favor.

坐.zh: 我认识那个坐得最靠近门的男孩。
坐.pinyin: Wǒ rèn shi nà ge zuò de zuì kào jìn mén de nán hái
坐.en: I know the boy who is sitting closest to the door.
坐.es: Conozco al chico que está sentado más cerca de la puerta.

已经.zh: 我已经看过这部电影了。
已经.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng kàn guo zhè bù diàn yǐng le
已经.en: I have seen the film before.

已经.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng chī bǎo le xiè xie
Xiàn zài tā yīng gāi yǐ jīng dào liǎo
已经.en: He should have arrived by now.

已经.pinyin: Tā xī wàng yǐ jīng chéng gōng le
已经.en: He hopes he has already succeeded.

作业.zh: 我做完了所有的回家作业。
作业.pinyin: Wǒ zuò wán le suǒ yǒu de huí jiā zuò yè

作业.zh: 我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。
作业.pinyin: Wǒ yòng le bǐ wǒ yù qī gèng cháng de shí jiān lái wán chéng zuò yè
作业.en: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
作业.es: La tarea me tomó más tiempo del que esperaba.

作业.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō zuò yè yào zuò
作业.en: I have a lot of homework to do.
作业.es: Tengo un montón de tarea por hacer.

作业.zh: 你自己做回家作业的吗?
作业.pinyin: Nǐ zì jǐ zuò huí jiā zuò yè de ma
作业.en: Did you do your homework by yourself?

太阳.zh: 我们走的时候下着雨，到的时候有太阳。
太阳.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒu de shí hou xià zhe yǔ dào de shí hou yǒu tài yang
太阳.en: It was raining when we left, but by the time we arrived, it was sunny.
太阳.es: Estaba lloviendo cuando nos fuimos, pero para cuando llegamos estaba soleado.

太阳.zh: 趁还有太阳的时候，我该洗衣服。
太阳.pinyin: Chèn hái yǒu tài yang de shí hou wǒ gāi xǐ yī fú
太阳.en: I have to do laundry while it's still sunny.
太阳.es: Tengo que lavar la ropa ahora que aún está soleado.

太阳.pinyin: Tài yang cóng hǎi shàng shēng qǐ le
太阳.en: The sun rose from the sea.
太阳.es: El sol se elevó desde el mar.

太阳.zh: 地球大约每三百六十五天就会围绕太阳旋转一周。
太阳.pinyin: Dì qiú dà yuē měi sān bǎi liù shí wǔ tiān jiù huì wéi rào tài yang xuán zhuǎn yī zhōu
太阳.en: The earth makes one revolution around the sun in about 365 days.
太阳.es: La Tierra da una vuelta al Sol en aproximadamente trescientos sesenta y cinco días.

首都.pinyin: Běi jīng shì zhōng guó de shǒu dū
首都.en: Beijing is the capital of China.
首都.es: Pekín es la capital de China.

首都.pinyin: Rì běn de shǒu dū shì dōng jīng
首都.en: The capital of Japan is Tokyo.
首都.es: La capital de Japón es Tokio.

首都.pinyin: Dōng jīng shì rì běn de shǒu dū
首都.en: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
首都.es: Tokio es la capital de Japón.

首都.pinyin: Bā lí shì fǎ guó de shǒu dū
首都.en: Paris is the capital of France.
首都.es: París es la capital de Francia.

盐.zh: 能不能请你把盐递给我？
盐.pinyin: Néng bù néng qǐng nǐ bǎ yán dì gěi wǒ
盐.en: Could you pass me the salt, please?

盐.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yán dì gěi wǒ
Zhè tāng lǐ yán fàng duō le
盐.en: There's too much salt in this soup.

盐.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yán dì gěi wǒ ná zhe
盐.en: "Pass me the salt, please." "Here you are."

其中.zh: 我的其中一个行李不见了。
其中.pinyin: Wǒ de qí zhōng yī ge xíng li bù jiàn le
其中.en: One of my suitcases is missing.
其中.es: Me falta una de mis maletas.

其中.zh: 我那天碰到了我其中的一个老朋友。
其中.pinyin: Wǒ nà tiān pèng dào le wǒ qí zhōng de yī ge lǎo péng you
其中.en: I met an old friend of mine the other day.
其中.es: Me encontré con un viejo amigo el otro día.

其中.zh: 汤姆是我朋友中的其中一位。
其中.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shì wǒ péng you zhòng dì qí zhōng yī wèi
其中.en: Tom is a friend of mine.

其中.zh: 你和我其中一个要出席这次的会议。
其中.pinyin: Nǐ hé wǒ qí zhōng yī ge yào chū xí zhè cì de huì yì
其中.en: Either you or I must attend the meeting.
其中.es: Uno de los dos debe asistir a la reunión.

提.en: She doesn't want to talk about it.
提.es: Ella no quiere hablar de eso.

提.zh: 她提着一只满是鲜花的篮子。
提.pinyin: Tā tí zhe yī zhǐ mǎn shì xiān huā de lán zi
提.en: She was carrying a basket full of flowers.
提.es: Ella llevaba una cesta llena de flores.

提.zh: 艾马提，我们需要更多肉！
提.pinyin: Ài mǎ tí wǒ men xū yào gèng duō ròu

提.zh: 不提英语，他还会说德语和法语。
提.pinyin: Bù tí yīng yǔ tā hái huì shuō dé yǔ hé fǎ yǔ
提.en: He knows German and French, not to mention English.
提.es: Él sabe alemán y francés, sin contar el inglés.

区别.zh: 他来不来对我来说没区别。
区别.pinyin: Tā lái bù lái duì wǒ lái shuō méi qū bié
区别.en: It makes no difference to me whether he comes or not.
区别.es: No me importa si él viene o no.

区别.zh: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
区别.pinyin: Nǐ néng gào su wǒ hóng chá hé lǜ chá de qū bié ma
区别.en: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
区别.es: ¿Podría indicarme la diferencia entre el té negro y el verde?

区别.pinyin: Zhè hé nà yǒu shén me qū bié
区别.en: What is the difference between this and that?
区别.es: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre esto y aquello?

区别.zh: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。
区别.pinyin: Lǐ lùn shàng shuō lǐ lùn hé shí jiàn méi yǒu qū bié dàn shí jiàn shàng shuō shì yǒu de
区别.en: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.
区别.es: En teoría, no hay ninguna diferencia entre la teoría y la práctica. Pero en la práctica sí.

说明.pinyin: Wǒ xià zhōu huì xiáng xì shuō míng de
说明.en: I'll explain it in detail next week.
说明.es: La semana que viene lo explicaré en detalle.

说明.pinyin: Zhè shén me dōu shuō míng bù le
Lǎo shī shuō míng le cí de yì si
说明.en: The teacher explained the meaning of the word to us.
说明.es: El profesor nos explicó el significado de la palabra.

说明.zh: 你可以说明一下这台机器是怎样运作的吗？
说明.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ shuō míng yī xià zhè tái jī qì shì zěn yàng yùn zuò de ma
说明.en: Can you explain how this machine works?

周围.pinyin: Wǒ kàn le kàn zhōu wéi
周围.es: Eché un ojo por mi alrededor.

周围.zh: 在那滩冰淇淋的周围，有一群蚂蚁在爬来爬去。
周围.pinyin: Zài nà tān bīng qí lín de zhōu wéi yǒu yī qún mǎ yǐ zài pá lái pá qù
周围.en: The area around the melting ice cream was crawling with ants.
周围.es: El área alrededor del helado que se derretía estaba plagada de hormigas.

周围.zh: 他可能在公园周围慢跑。
周围.pinyin: Tā kě néng zài gōng yuán zhōu wéi màn pǎo
周围.en: He may be jogging around the park.
周围.es: Puede que él esté haciendo footing por el parque.

周围.zh: 周围环境怎么样？静不静？夜晚闹不闹？
周围.pinyin: Zhōu wéi huán jìng zěn me yàng jìng bù jìng yè wǎn nào bù nào
周围.en: How's the neighborhood? Quiet? Noisy at night?
周围.es: ¿Cómo es el vecindario? ¿Silencioso? ¿Hay ruido por las noches?

将来.zh: 我感觉你将来会成为一名优秀的律师。
将来.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn jué nǐ jiāng lái huì chéng wéi yī míng yōu xiù de lǜ shī
将来.en: I have a feeling you'll be a very good lawyer.
将来.es: Tengo el sentimiento de que serás un muy buen abogado.

将来.zh: 在不久的将来这些问题都会迎刃而解。
将来.pinyin: Zài bù jiǔ de jiāng lái zhè xiē wèn tí dū huì yíng rèn ér jiě
将来.en: These problems will be solved in the near future.
将来.es: Estos problemas se resolverán en un futuro próximo.

将来.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jiāng lái zhù yì diǎn
将来.en: Please take more care in the future.
将来.es: Por favor, ten más cuidado en el futuro.

将来.zh: 谁能说将来会发生什么呢。
将来.pinyin: Shéi néng shuō jiāng lái huì fā shēng shén me ne
将来.en: Who can tell what will happen in the future?
将来.es: ¿Quién puede decir lo que pasará en el futuro?

表演.zh: 我们希望你喜欢这个表演。
表演.pinyin: Wǒ men xī wàng nǐ xǐ huan zhè ge biǎo yǎn
表演.en: We hope you will enjoy the show.
表演.es: Esperamos que le guste el show.

表演.pinyin: Wǒ men wèi biǎo yǎn zhě gǔ zhǎng
表演.en: We gave the performer a round of applause.
表演.es: Nosotros le dimos un aplauso al intérprete.

表演.pinyin: Xià yī chǎng biǎo yǎn zài jǐ diǎn zhōng
表演.en: What time is the next performance?
表演.es: ¿A qué hora es la siguiente representación?

表演.pinyin: Xué sheng men biǎo yǎn hā mǔ léi tè

相同.pinyin: Nǐ hé wǒ yǒu xiāng tóng de xiǎng fǎ
相同.en: You and I have the same idea.
相同.es: Tú y yo tenemos la misma idea.

相同.pinyin: Tā men yǒu xiāng tóng de shì hào
Nǐ yòu fàn le xiāng tóng de cuò wù
相同.en: You have made the very same mistake again.
相同.es: Has cometido el mismo error otra vez.

相同.zh: 我和她在公司里职位相同，但她赚的钱比我多。
相同.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā zài gōng sī lǐ zhí wèi xiāng tóng dàn tā zhuàn de qián bǐ wǒ duō
相同.en: She and I hold the same position in the company, but she earns more than I do.
相同.es: Tenemos funciones similares dentro de la empresa, pero ella gana más que yo.

排队.zh: “我的车不需要排队阿，”他提议。
排队.pinyin: Wǒ de chē bù xū yào pái duì ā tā tí yì
排队.en: "You don't have to queue for my car," he offers.
排队.es: "No tienes que esperar por mi coche", le comentó.

排队.zh: 我到银行去，很幸运地不必排队。
排队.pinyin: Wǒ dào yín háng qù hěn xìng yùn de bù bì pái duì
排队.en: I got to the bank and luckily didn't have to get in line.
排队.es: Fui al banco y, afortunadamente, no tuve que hacer cola.

排队.pinyin: Tā men pái duì děng gōng chē
排队.en: They waited in line for the bus.
排队.es: Ellos esperaron en fila el bus.

排队.pinyin: Xǔ duō rén zài pái duì děng hòu
排队.en: Many people were waiting in line.
排队.es: Mucha gente estaba esperando en fila.

激动.pinyin: Wǒ jī dòng de shuì bù zháo

精彩.zh: 我读了一篇精彩的故事。
精彩.pinyin: Wǒ dú le yī piān jīng cǎi de gù shi

精彩.zh: 我们生活在一个精彩的时代。
精彩.pinyin: Wǒ men shēng huó zài yī ge jīng cǎi de shí dài
精彩.en: We live in a wonderful period.

精彩.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。
精彩.pinyin: Yǎn jiǎng zhě jīng cǎi de yǎn shuō gěi wǒ men liú xià le shēn kè de yìn xiàng
精彩.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
精彩.es: Estábamos profundamente impresionados por el elocuente discurso del expositor.

精彩.zh: 你一定不要错过这部精彩的电影。
精彩.pinyin: Nǐ yī dìng bù yào cuò guò zhè bù jīng cǎi de diàn yǐng
精彩.en: You mustn't miss seeing this wonderful film.
精彩.es: No debes perder verte esta maravillosa película.

尤其.zh: 我很喜欢奈良，尤其在秋季的时候。
尤其.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐ huan nài liáng yóu qí zài qiū jì de shí hou
尤其.en: I love Nara, particularly in the fall.
尤其.es: Me encanta Nara, sobre todo en otoño.

尤其.zh: 他们主要输出的产品是纺织品，尤其以丝绸和绵为主。
尤其.pinyin: Tā men zhǔ yào shū chū de chǎn pǐn shì fǎng zhī pǐn yóu qí yǐ sī chóu hé mián wéi zhǔ
尤其.en: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
尤其.es: Sus principales productos de exportación son textiles, especialmente la seda y el algodón.

尤其.pinyin: Nǐ yóu qí bù gāi kōng fù hē jiǔ
尤其.en: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
尤其.es: No debes tomar, sobre todo con el estómago vacío.

干杯.zh: 请诸位斟满酒，为新郎和新娘干杯！
干杯.pinyin: Qǐng zhū wèi zhēn mǎn jiǔ wèi xīn láng hé xīn niáng gān bēi
干杯.en: Please charge your glasses and drink a toast to the bride and groom!

微笑.zh: 只要你微笑，我就会快乐。
微笑.pinyin: Zhǐ yào nǐ wēi xiào wǒ jiù huì kuài lè
微笑.en: If you smile, I'll be happy.
微笑.es: Si tú sonríes, yo soy feliz.

微笑.pinyin: Dàn shì tā bù cháng wēi xiào
微笑.en: But he did not often smile.
微笑.es: Pero él no sonríe con frecuencia.

微笑.zh: 照片中的每一个人都在微笑著。
微笑.pinyin: Zhào piàn zhòng dì měi yī gè rén dōu zài wēi xiào zhe
微笑.en: Everybody in the picture is smiling.
微笑.es: Todos los que salen en la foto están sonriendo.

微笑.pinyin: Zhào piàn lǐ de nǚ hái zài wēi xiào
微笑.en: The girl in the picture is smiling.
微笑.es: La niña en la foto está sonriendo.

处理.pinyin: Wǒ huì chǔ lǐ zhè ge wèn tí
处理.en: I will deal with this problem.

处理.zh: 你从来没时间处理重要的事情！
处理.pinyin: Nǐ cóng lái méi shí jiān chǔ lǐ zhòng yào de shì qing
处理.en: You never have time for important things!
处理.es: ¡Nunca tienes tiempo para las cosas importantes!

处理.zh: 他说：“日本管理层必须学会如何处理美国员工。”
处理.pinyin: Tā shuō rì běn guǎn lǐ céng bì xū xué huì rú hé chǔ lǐ měi guó yuán gōng
处理.en: Japanese management must learn how to deal with American workers, he said.
处理.es: Él dijo, "La administración japonesa debe aprender como tratar con los trabajadores americanos".

家庭.zh: 这个家庭热情地接待了我。
家庭.pinyin: Zhè ge jiā tíng rè qíng dì jiē dāi le wǒ
家庭.en: The family received me very warmly.
家庭.es: La familia me recibió de forma muy cálida.

家庭.zh: 上星期天我的家庭去了动物园看熊猫。
家庭.pinyin: Shàng xīng qī tiān wǒ de jiā tíng qù le dòng wù yuán kàn xióng māo
家庭.en: My family went to the zoo to see pandas last Sunday.
家庭.es: El domingo pasado mi familia fue al zoológico a ver pandas.

家庭.zh: 你最好立刻去看你的家庭医生。
家庭.pinyin: Nǐ zuì hǎo lì kè qù kàn nǐ de jiā tíng yī shēng
家庭.en: You'd better go to see your family doctor at once.
家庭.es: Deberías ir a ver a tu médico de cabecera de inmediato.

家庭.pinyin: Duō měi hǎo de jiā tíng a

作为.zh: 以前人们用烟作为联络信号。
作为.pinyin: Yǐ qián rén men yòng yān zuò wéi lián luò xìn hào
作为.en: Back then, people communicated using smoke signals.
作为.es: Antiguamente la gente se comunicaba con señales de humo.

作为.zh: 我们应该根据他的作为来评判他。
作为.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi gēn jù tā de zuò wéi lái píng pàn tā
作为.en: We should judge him according to his actions.

作为.zh: 作为回报，我给了她一个娃娃。
作为.pinyin: Zuò wéi huí bào wǒ gěi le tā yī ge wá wa
作为.en: I gave her a doll in return.

作为.zh: 我们毕业的时候送了一个桌上时钟给他作为谢礼。
作为.pinyin: Wǒ men bì yè de shí hou sòng le yī ge zhuō shàng shí zhōng gěi tā zuò wéi xiè lǐ
作为.en: On leaving school, we presented him with a table clock as a token of our thanks.

某.zh: 我想去欧洲的某个地方。
某.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù ōu zhōu de mǒu gè dì fang
某.en: I want to go somewhere in Europe.
某.es: Quiero ir a alguna parte de Europa.

某.pinyin: Tā qù le mǒu gè dì fang
某.en: He went to some place or other.

某.zh: 我的雨伞遗失在公园里某个地方。我必须再买一把。
某.pinyin: Wǒ de yǔ sǎn yí shī zài gōng yuán lǐ mǒu gè dì fang wǒ bì xū zài mǎi yī bǎ
某.en: I have lost my umbrella somewhere in the park. I have to buy one.
某.es: Se me perdió mi paraguas en alguna parte en el parque. Tengo que comprar uno nuevo.

某.zh: 你们可以搜索含有某个词的句子并得到这些句子的翻译。
某.pinyin: Nǐ men kě yǐ sōu suǒ hán yǒu mǒu gè cí de jù zi bìng dé dào zhè xiē jù zi de fān yì
某.en: You can search sentences containing a certain word and get translations for these sentences.
某.es: Puedes buscar oraciones que contengan una palabra determinada y obtener traducciones para estas oraciones.

木头.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì mù tou zuò de

木头.zh: 这个玩具是用木头做的。
木头.pinyin: Zhè ge wán jù shì yòng mù tou zuò de
木头.en: That toy is made of wood.
木头.es: El juguete está hecho de madera.

木头.zh: 他用一块木头刻出一尊佛像。
木头.pinyin: Tā yòng yī kuài mù tou kè chū yī zūn fó xiàng
木头.en: He carved a Buddha statue from wood.
木头.es: Él talló una imagen budista en madera.

木头.pinyin: Mù tou néng fú zài shuǐ miàn shàng
木头.es: La madera flota en el agua.

建立.zh: 握著我的手。我们两个将要建立一个乌托邦。
建立.pinyin: Wò zhe wǒ de shǒu wǒ men liǎng gè jiāng yào jiàn lì yī ge wū tuō bāng
建立.en: Take my hand. The two of us are going to construct a utopia.
建立.es: Toma mi mano. Los dos vamos a construir una utopía.

建立.zh: 这是建立在猜测的基础上。
建立.pinyin: Zhè shì jiàn lì zài cāi cè de jī chǔ shàng

建立.zh: 他们大约五百年前在秘鲁建立了帝国。
建立.pinyin: Tā men dà yuē wǔ bǎi nián qián zài bì lǔ jiàn lì le dì guó
建立.en: They built their empire in Peru about five hundred years ago.
建立.es: Ellos construyeron su imperio en Perú hace aproximadamente quinientos años.

建立.pinyin: Tā men jiàn lì le yī ge wǎng zhàn

婚姻.pinyin: Tā de hūn yīn guān hěn jī xíng
婚姻.en: His view on marriage is abnormal.
婚姻.es: Su opinión sobre el matrimonio es anormal.

婚姻.zh: 婚姻是造成离婚的主因。
婚姻.pinyin: Hūn yīn shì zào chéng lí hūn de zhǔ yīn
婚姻.en: Marriage is the main cause of divorce.
婚姻.es: El matrimonio es la principal causa de divorcio.

婚姻.zh: 婚姻的长度与婚宴的花费负相关。
婚姻.pinyin: Hūn yīn de cháng dù yǔ hūn yàn de huā fèi fù xiāng guān
婚姻.en: The length of a marriage is inversely proportional to the cost of the wedding.
婚姻.es: La duración de un matrimonio es inversamente proporcional al precio de la boda.

婚姻.pinyin: Yǒu xiē rén hài pà hūn yīn
婚姻.es: El matrimonio asusta a algunas personas.

池塘.zh: 他扔了一块石头到池塘里。
池塘.pinyin: Tā rēng le yī kuài shí tou dào chí táng lǐ
池塘.en: He threw a rock into the pond.
池塘.es: Él tiró una piedra en el estanque.

池塘.zh: 池塘的四周以前种满了大树。
池塘.pinyin: Chí táng de sì zhōu yǐ qián zhǒng mǎn le dà shù
池塘.en: There used to be big trees around the pond.
池塘.es: Solía haber árboles grandes alrededor de la charca.

池塘.pinyin: Tāng mǔ diào jìn le chí táng
池塘.es: Tom se cayó a la piscina.

池塘.zh: 以前在这个池塘里有许多青蛙。
池塘.pinyin: Yǐ qián zài zhè ge chí táng lǐ yǒu xǔ duō qīng wā
池塘.en: There used to be a lot of frogs in this pond.
池塘.es: Solía haber un montón de ranas en este estanque.

捐.zh: 我不太确定他希望我捐多少。
捐.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài què dìng tā xī wàng wǒ juān duō shao
捐.en: I'm not sure how much they are expecting me to donate.

捐.zh: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。
捐.pinyin: Tāng mǔ juān yī bàn tā de xīn shuǐ gěi tā zuì xǐ huan de cí shàn jī gòu
捐.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.

捐.zh: 我一得到一大笔钱就捐一部分给慈善机构。
捐.pinyin: Wǒ yī dé dào yī dà bǐ qián jiù juān yī bù fen gěi cí shàn jī gòu
捐.en: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.

谈判.zh: 外交谈判帮助结束了冲突。
谈判.pinyin: Wài jiāo tán pàn bāng zhù jié shù le chōng tū
谈判.en: Diplomatic dialogue helped put an end to the conflict.
谈判.es: La discusión diplomática ayudó a ponerle fin al conflicto.

谈判.zh: 这不过是他在谈判最后时刻尽可能最大化利润的尝试。
谈判.pinyin: Zhè bu guo shì tā zài tán pàn zuì hòu shí kè jǐn kě néng zuì dà huà lì rùn de cháng shì
谈判.en: It's just an attempt on his part to maximize profits, as much as possible, in the last moments of negotiations.

谈判.zh: 我可以做中英双向翻译，参加跟外国人交际谈判。
谈判.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ zuò zhōng yīng shuāng xiàng fān yì cān jiā gēn wài guó rén jiāo jì tán pàn
谈判.en: I can translate between Chinese and English, and can participate in negotiations with foreigners.

农业.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
农业.pinyin: Zhèng fǔ yīng gāi jiā dà duì nóng yè de tóu zī
农业.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
农业.es: El gobierno debería invertir más dinero en la agricultura.

农业.zh: 农业需要消耗大量的水。
农业.pinyin: Nóng yè xū yào xiāo hào dà liàng de shuǐ
农业.en: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.

农业.zh: 这片地不适合发展农业。
农业.pinyin: Zhè piān de bù shì gě fā zhǎn nóng yè
农业.en: This land is not suitable for agriculture.

青少年.zh: 汤姆第一次上电视后就广受青少年的欢迎。
青少年.pinyin: Tāng mǔ dì yī cì shàng diàn shì hòu jiù yǎn shòu qīng shào nián de huān yíng
青少年.en: Tom became popular among teenagers as soon as he made his debut on the screen.
青少年.es: Tom se hizo popular entre las adolescentes apenas hizo su debut en la pantalla.

青少年.zh: 汤姆是个普通的青少年。
青少年.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shì gè pǔ tōng de qīng shào nián

青少年.zh: 汤姆是一位青少年偶像。
青少年.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shì yī wèi qīng shào nián ǒu xiàng

青少年.zh: 交通事故是美国青少年死亡的主要原因。
青少年.pinyin: Jiāo tōng shì gù shì měi guó qīng shào nián sǐ wáng de zhǔ yào yuán yīn
青少年.en: Car accidents are the leading cause of death for teenagers in the United States.

骨头.zh: 汤姆的手臂和手断了些骨头。
骨头.pinyin: Tāng mǔ de shǒu bì hé shǒu duàn le xiē gǔ tou
骨头.en: Tom broke some bones in his arm and hand.

骨头.zh: 四处奔跑的狗找到了骨头。
骨头.pinyin: Sì chù bēn pǎo de gǒu zhǎo dào le gǔ tou
骨头.en: The dog that trots about finds a bone.

维修.zh: 我的磁带录音机需要维修。
维修.pinyin: Wǒ de cí dài lù yīn jī xū yào wéi xiū
维修.en: My cassette tape recorder needs fixing.

维修.pinyin: Zhè jiān fáng zi yào wéi xiū le
维修.en: This house must be done up.

维修.zh: 真的凑巧，这两样现在还在维修。
维修.pinyin: Zhēn de còu qiǎo zhè liǎng yàng xiàn zài hái zài wéi xiū
维修.en: Completely coincidentally, these two are still being repaired.

此外.pinyin: Cǐ wài tā yǒu yì shù jiā tiān fù
此外.en: In addition, she has an artistic flair.

此外.zh: 此外，中国人喜欢睡午觉。
此外.pinyin: Cǐ wài zhōng guó rén xǐ huan shuì wǔ jiào
此外.en: What's more, Chinese people like taking naps.

激烈.zh: 我们激烈的讨论了这个问题。
激烈.pinyin: Wǒ men jī liè de tǎo lùn le zhè ge wèn tí
激烈.en: We had a heated discussion about it.

用途.zh: 文字处理软件和电脑不同的是，它只有一个用途。
用途.pinyin: Wén zì chǔ lǐ ruǎn jiàn hé diàn nǎo bù tóng de shì tā zhǐ yǒu yī ge yòng tú
用途.en: Compared to a computer, a word processor has a single purpose.

躲藏.pinyin: Tā wèi shén me zài duǒ cáng

噪音.pinyin: Zào yīn bǎ wǒ chǎo xǐng le

噪音.zh: 你必须忍受这一切的噪音了。
噪音.pinyin: Nǐ bì xū rěn shòu zhè yī qiè de zào yīn le
噪音.en: You have to put up with all this noise.
噪音.es: Tienes que soportar todo este ruido.

噪音.zh: 她叫我们不要制造噪音。
噪音.pinyin: Tā jiào wǒ men bù yào zhì zào zào yīn
噪音.en: She told us not to make a noise.
噪音.es: Ella nos dijo que no diéramos un ruido.

噪音.zh: 我无法再忍受那噪音了。
噪音.pinyin: Wǒ wú fǎ zài rěn shòu nà zào yīn le
噪音.en: I can't put up with that noise any longer.
噪音.es: Ya no puedo aguantar más ese ruido.

城堡.pinyin: Gěi wǒ zhè zuò chéng bǎo de yào shi
城堡.en: Give me the key to this castle!

城堡.pinyin: Chéng bǎo zài hé de duì miàn
城堡.en: The castle is across the river.
城堡.es: El castillo está al otro lado del río.

城堡.zh: 山脚下有一座古老的城堡。
城堡.pinyin: Shān jiǎo xià yǒu yī zuò gǔ lǎo de chéng bǎo
城堡.en: There is an old castle at the foot of the mountain.
城堡.es: Hay un viejo castillo al pie de la montaña.

城堡.pinyin: Zhè ge chéng bǎo hǎo měi

强迫.pinyin: Méi yǒu rén qiǎng pò nǐ bāng wǒ
强迫.en: Nobody forced you to help me.

强迫.pinyin: Tā qiǎng pò tā chī bō cài
强迫.en: She forced him to eat spinach.
强迫.es: Ella le obligó a comer espinacas.

强迫.zh: 学习不该被强迫，而是该被鼓励。
强迫.pinyin: Xué xí bù gāi bèi qiǎng pò ér shì gāi bèi gǔ lì
强迫.en: Learning should not be forced, but rather encouraged.
强迫.es: El aprendizaje no debe ser forzado, sino estimulado.

强迫.pinyin: Tā qiǎng pò wǒ dào nà li qù
强迫.en: He forced me to go there.

制服.pinyin: Wǒ men zài xué xiào chuān zhì fú
制服.en: We wear uniforms at our school.

制服.zh: 有个穿白色制服的女孩帮我量了体温。
制服.pinyin: Yǒu gè chuān bái sè zhì fú de nǚ hái bāng wǒ liáng le tǐ wēn
制服.en: The girl in a white uniform took my temperature.
制服.es: La niña vestida de uniforme blanco me tomó la temperatura.

制服.pinyin: Tā men quán bù chuān zhì fú le
制服.en: They were all dressed in uniforms.

制服.pinyin: Tā men dōu chuān zhuó zhì fú

客户.zh: 投资者把他客户的资金窃取了。
客户.pinyin: Tóu zī zhě bǎ tā kè hù de zī jīn qiè qǔ le
客户.en: The investor stole the capital of his client.
客户.es: El inversor robó el capital de su cliente.

客户.zh: 催促客户去完成一件任务是很让人头疼的事。
客户.pinyin: Cuī cù kè hù qù wán chéng yī jiàn rèn wu shì hěn ràng rén tóu téng de shì
客户.en: Pushing customers to complete a task can be a headache.

客户.zh: 三把叉子是一家供应啤酒的酒吧，其目标客户是旅行者。
客户.pinyin: Sān bǎ chā zi shì yī jiā gōng yìng pí jiǔ de jiǔ bā qí mù biāo kè hù shì lǚ xíng zhě
客户.en: The Three Forks is a bar serving beer, and its target audience are travellers.

客户.zh: 不能按时交付货款的话会给客户带来很大损失。
客户.pinyin: Bù néng àn shí jiāo fù huò kuǎn de huà huì gěi kè hù dài lái hěn dà sǔn shī
客户.en: Not being able to carry out payments on time can cause very large losses for the consumer.

罐.zh: 我构不到那罐番茄罐头。
罐.pinyin: Wǒ gòu bù dào nà guàn fān qié guàn tou
罐.en: I can't reach that can of tomatoes.
罐.es: No puedo alcanzar esa lata de tomate.

罐.pinyin: Zhǐ shèng xià yī guàn ròu le
罐.en: There is only one can of meat left.
罐.es: Sólo queda una lata de carne.

罐.pinyin: Méi gé mǎi le yī guàn xī hóng shì
罐.en: Meg bought a can of tomatoes.
罐.es: Meg compró una lata de tomates.

罐.zh: 水梨在这家工厂进行装罐。
罐.pinyin: Shuǐ lí zài zhè jiā gōng chǎng jìn xíng zhuāng guàn
罐.en: Nashi are tinned in this factory.

祖国.pinyin: Wǒ ài wǒ de zǔ guó
Tā de zǔ guó shì dé guó
Wǒ shēn ài wǒ de zǔ guó
祖国.en: I love my country with every fiber of my being.

祖国.zh: 不在祖国的时候我很想家，但是在家的时候我又想旅游。
祖国.pinyin: Bù zài zǔ guó de shí hou wǒ hěn xiǎng jiā dàn shì zài jiā de shí hou wǒ yòu xiǎng lǚ yóu
祖国.en: When I'm away from home, I miss it dearly, but when I am at home, I want to travel.

抚养.zh: 我被我的祖母抚养长大。
抚养.pinyin: Wǒ bèi wǒ de zǔ mǔ fǔ yǎng zhǎng dà
抚养.en: I was brought up by my grandmother.

抚养.pinyin: Tā shì zěn me fǔ yǎng hái zi de
抚养.en: How does she bring up her children?

抚养.zh: 他被他的叔叔抚养长大。
抚养.pinyin: Tā bèi tā de shū shu fǔ yǎng zhǎng dà
抚养.en: He was brought up by his uncle.
抚养.es: Él fue educado por su tío.

抚养.zh: 虽然她在日本被抚养长大，但是她精通英语。
抚养.pinyin: Suī rán tā zài rì běn bèi fǔ yǎng zhǎng dà dàn shì tā jīng tōng yīng yǔ
抚养.en: She has a good command of English though she was brought up in Japan.
抚养.es: Ella tiene un buen dominio de inglés, a pesar de haberse criado en Japón.

颤抖.zh: 恐怖的场面让了他颤抖。
颤抖.pinyin: Kǒng bù de chǎng miàn ràng le tā chàn dǒu
颤抖.en: The terrible scene made him shudder.
颤抖.es: Se estremeció ante la terrible escena.

颤抖.zh: 即使您的声音颤抖，也要说出事实。
颤抖.pinyin: Jí shǐ nín de shēng yīn chàn dǒu yě yào shuō chū shì shí
颤抖.en: Speak the truth, even if your voice shakes.
颤抖.es: Di la verdad aunque te tiemble la voz.

颤抖.zh: 他边颤抖边说：「那座城堡有鬼。」
颤抖.pinyin: Tā biān chàn dǒu biān shuō nà zuò chéng bǎo yǒu guǐ
颤抖.en: "The castle is haunted," he said with a shiver.

颤抖.pinyin: Tā xīng fèn de chàn dǒu le qǐ lai

人士.zh: 我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。
人士.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng zài xún zhǎo kě yǐ bāng wǒ xiū gǎi zhè piān lùn wén de mǔ yǔ rén shì
人士.en: I am looking for a native speaker who can correct this paper for me.
人士.es: Estoy buscando a un hablante nativo que me pueda ayudar a corregir este ensayo.

人士.zh: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。
人士.pinyin: Zhī míng wén xué jiè rén shì zuó wǎn qí jù yī táng
人士.en: Noted literary personalities gathered together last evening.

人士.zh: 玛丽很快就注意到普丁并不是民主人士。
人士.pinyin: Mǎ lì hěn kuài jiù zhù yì dào pǔ dīng bìng bù shì mín zhǔ rén shì
人士.en: Mary quickly noticed that Putin was not a democrat.

出身.zh: 但是歌手并不否认她的出身。
出身.pinyin: Dàn shì gē shǒu bìng bù fǒu rèn tā de chū shēn
出身.en: However, the singer does not deny her ancestry.
出身.es: Sin embargo, la cantante no reniega de sus orígenes.

出身.en: I grew up in a poor family.

书法.pinyin: Wǒ duì shū fǎ lüè zhī yī èr
书法.en: I know a bit about calligraphy.

书法.pinyin: Nǐ shàn cháng shū fǎ ma

消除.zh: 美国的任务是将共产主义从世界上消除。
消除.pinyin: Měi guó de rèn wu shì jiāng gòng chǎn zhǔ yì cóng shì jiè shàng xiāo chú
消除.en: The American mission is to eliminate communism from the world.

消除.zh: 能付出爱心就是福，能消除烦恼就是慧。
消除.pinyin: Néng fù chū ài xīn jiù shì fú néng xiāo chú fán nǎo jiù shì huì
消除.en: Knowing how to love is success; knowing how to relax is wisdom.

消除.zh: 证实她顺利地过渡入皇室组织，有帮于消除这些焦虑。
消除.pinyin: Zhèng shí tā shùn lì de guò dù rù huáng shì zǔ zhī yǒu bāng yú xiāo chú zhè xiē jiāo lǜ
消除.en: Her smooth entry into the ranks of the royal family will help to dispel these fears.

瞄准.pinyin: Jǐng chá miáo zhǔn le nà ge nán rén
瞄准.en: The policeman aimed his gun at the man.
瞄准.es: El policía le apuntó con su pistola al hombre.

瞄准.pinyin: Miáo zhǔn má què jī zhòng é
瞄准.en: I aimed at a sparrow, but shot down a goose.
瞄准.es: Apunté a un gorrión, pero abatí una oca.

瞄准.pinyin: Tā miáo zhǔn le què méi mìng zhōng

瞄准.zh: 猎人们用枪瞄准了大象。
瞄准.pinyin: Liè rén men yòng qiāng miáo zhǔn le dà xiàng
瞄准.en: The hunters aimed at the elephant.

神仙.pinyin: Shén xiān zhǐ zài tóng huà lǐ cún zài
神仙.en: Fairies exist only in fairy tales.
神仙.es: Las hadas existen solo en cuentos de hadas.

神仙.zh: 从来就没有什么救世主， 也不靠神仙皇帝！
神仙.pinyin: Cóng lái jiù méi yǒu shén me jiù shì zhǔ yě bù kào shén xiān huáng dì
神仙.en: There has never been a savior nor an immortal emperor to rely on.

警惕.pinyin: Bù yào fàng sōng jǐng tì

侮辱.pinyin: Tāng mǔ méi xiǎng wǔ rǔ shéi
侮辱.en: Tom didn't mean to insult anybody.

周年.zh: 下个月是他们的五十周年纪念，他们打算重新宣誓。
周年.pinyin: Xià gè yuè shì tā men de wǔ shí zhōu nián jì niàn tā men dǎ suàn chóng xīn xuān shì
周年.en: Next month is their 50th anniversary, and they're planning on renewing their vows.

周年.zh: 汤姆从没忘记在婚礼周年纪念日送给他妻子花。
周年.pinyin: Tāng mǔ cóng méi wàng jì zài hūn lǐ zhōu nián jì niàn rì sòng gěi tā qī zi huā
周年.en: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.

周年.pinyin: Zhōu nián jì niàn hěn zhòng yào

守护.zh: 默默守护中，有人跑到街头，叫来了协警。
守护.pinyin: Mò mò shǒu hù zhōng yǒu rén páo dào jiē tóu jiào lái le xié jǐng

腐蚀.pinyin: Suān xìng fǔ shí le jīn shǔ

掐.pinyin: Fàng kāi wǒ nǐ zhèng zài qiā zhe wǒ de bó zi
掐.en: Let me go, you're choking me.

做主.zh: 这次校庆时，他将第一次做主角。
做主.pinyin: Zhè cì xiào qìng shí tā jiāng dì yī cì zuò zhǔ jiǎo
做主.en: He will play the leading role for the first time in the next school festival.

历来.zh: 这是我们历来经历过最大的地震。
历来.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ men lì lái jīng lì guo zuì dà de dì zhèn
历来.en: The earthquake was the biggest one that we had ever experienced.

叮嘱.zh: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。
叮嘱.pinyin: Zhēn de bù gǎn xiāng xìn nǐ zài chī yī shēng dīng zhǔ bù yào shí yòng de dōng xi

延续.pinyin: Zhè shù lín yán xù shǔ lǐ
延续.en: This forest goes on for a while.

截至.zh: 截至上周，我还没有收到答覆。

父母.zh: 我父母去机场送我叔叔了。

父母.zh: 我跟父母讲了留学的事情。

父母.zh: 让我介绍我父母给你认识。

并不.zh: 这并不是因为我恨他，相反我爱他。
并不.pinyin: Zhè bìng bù shì yīn wèi wǒ hèn tā xiāng fǎn wǒ ài tā
并不.en: It is not because I hate him, but because I love him.
并不.es: No es porque le odie, sino porque le amo.

并不.es: En sentido estricto, su respuesta es incorrecta.

并不.zh: 我并不反对你出去工作，可是小孩靠谁来照看呢？

并不.en: I don't object to your going out to work, but who will look after the children?
并不.es: No me opongo a que vayas a trabajar fuera de casa, pero ¿quién se ocupará de los niños?

并不.zh: 即使他有些小聪明，但是他并不智慧。
并不.pinyin: Jí shǐ tā yǒu xiē xiǎo cōng ming dàn shì tā bìng bù zhì huì
并不.en: Though he is clever, he isn't wise.
并不.es: Aunque es listo no es sabio.

成.zh: 他把他的自行车刷成红色。

从没.zh: 我从没见过那么大的西瓜！

里面.zh: 这箱子是空的，里面什么也没有。

里面.en: This box is empty. It has nothing in it.

齐.en: Ziri placed flowers on the balcony railing.

一周.pinyin: Pài duì yán qī le yī zhōu

赢得.en: The audience clapped loudly after his speech.

预约.pinyin: Jié kè jué dìng qǔ xiāo yù yuē
预约.en: Jack decided to cancel the reservations.

预约.pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ de yù yuē kǎ

周五.zh: 今天是周五，明天就是周末了！
周五.pinyin: Jīn tiān shì zhōu wǔ míng tiān jiù shì zhōu mò le
周五.en: Today is Friday. The weekend starts already tomorrow!
周五.es: Hoy es viernes, ¡mañana ya es fin de semana!

周五.pinyin: Tā zhōu yī dào zhōu wǔ shàng bān
周五.en: He works from Monday to Friday.

周五.pinyin: Nǐ jué de zhōu wǔ zěn me yàng
Xuě cóng zhōu yī xià dào zhōu wǔ
周五.en: It snowed from Monday to Friday.
周五.es: Nevó desde el lunes hasta el viernes.

搞错.zh: 他老是把我和我姐姐搞错。
搞错.pinyin: Tā lǎo shi bǎ wǒ hé wǒ jiě jie gǎo cuò
搞错.en: He always mistakes me for my sister.
搞错.es: Él siempre me confunde con mi hermana mayor.

搞错.pinyin: Kàn lai tā gǎo cuò le
搞错.en: It appears that he is mistaken.

搞错.zh: 不好意思，我把方向搞错了。
搞错.pinyin: Bù hǎo yì si wǒ bǎ fāng xiàng gǎo cuò le
搞错.en: I'm sorry I've mistaken the direction.

眼泪.pinyin: Wǒ méi fǎ rěn zhù wǒ de yǎn lèi
眼泪.en: I could not keep the tears from my eyes.

眼泪.zh: 这首歌太感人了，使我不禁流下了眼泪。
眼泪.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē tài gǎn rén le shǐ wǒ bù jīn liú xià le yǎn lèi
眼泪.en: This song is so moving that it brings tears to my eyes.
眼泪.es: Esta canción me emociona tanto que me hace lagrimear.

眼泪.zh: 她的眼泪已经告诉了发生了什么。
眼泪.pinyin: Tā de yǎn lèi yǐ jīng gào su le fā shēng le shén me
眼泪.en: Her tears have already told me what has happened.
眼泪.es: Las lágrimas de ella relataban lo que había pasado.

眼泪.zh: 眼泪顺着她的脸颊流下来。
眼泪.pinyin: Yǎn lèi shùn zhe tā de liǎn jiá liú xià lai
眼泪.en: Tears were flowing down her cheeks.

运.en: We rented a truck to move our furniture.
运.es: Alquilamos un camión para trasladar nuestros muebles.

运.zh: 在汤姆前往波士顿之前，我能和他说话可真算是走了运。
运.pinyin: Zài tāng mǔ qián wǎng bō shì dùn zhī qián wǒ néng hé tā shuō huà kě zhēn suàn shì zǒu le yùn
运.en: It was lucky I was able to speak to Tom before he left for Boston.
运.es: Tuve suerte de poder hablar con Tom antes de que se fuera a Boston.

楼上.zh: 我的房间在楼上的左边。
楼上.pinyin: Wǒ de fáng jiān zài lóu shàng de zuǒ bian
楼上.en: My room is upstairs on the left.

楼上.en: Would you carry my luggage upstairs?

上衣.zh: 我觉得是时候洗这件上衣了。
上衣.pinyin: Wǒ jué de shì shí hou xǐ zhè jiàn shàng yī le
上衣.en: I think it's time for me to wash this shirt.
上衣.es: Creo que es hora de que lave esta camisa.

上衣.zh: 我喜欢那件紫色的上衣。

上衣.zh: 这条领带和那件上衣很配。
上衣.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lǐng dài hé nà jiàn shàng yī hěn pèi
上衣.en: This tie and that jacket go well together.
上衣.es: Esta corbata conjunta con aquella chaqueta.

上衣.pinyin: Nán rén men chuān zhuó duǎn xiù shàng yī
上衣.en: The men are wearing short sleeves.
上衣.es: Los hombres van en manga corta.

帐.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng fù zhàng xiè xie
帐.en: I'd like to pay the check, please.
帐.es: Quisiera pagar la cuenta, por favor.

帐.zh: 我可以用信用卡付帐吗?
帐.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ yòng xìn yòng kǎ fù zhàng ma
帐.en: Can I pay by credit card?

帐.zh: 我们会用银行转帐付款。
帐.pinyin: Wǒ men huì yòng yín háng zhuǎn zhàng fù kuǎn
帐.en: We will make the payment by bank transfer.

帐.zh: 算帐愈是精确, 友谊愈是坚定。
帐.pinyin: Suàn zhàng yù shì jīng què yǒu yì yù shì jiān dìng
帐.en: The more precise the calculations, the stronger the friendship.

所在.pinyin: Wǒ men jiù shì wèn tí suǒ zài

所在.zh: 地图帮助我们知道所在的位置。
所在.pinyin: Dì tú bāng zhù wǒ men zhī dào suǒ zài de wèi zhi
所在.en: A map helps us to know where we are.
所在.es: Un mapa nos ayuda a saber dónde estamos.

作出.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ de gōng zuò zuò chū le míng què zhǐ shì
作出.en: He gave me precise instructions to do the job.

作出.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shì zuì xiān zuò chū fǎn yìng de

作出.zh: 我们会根据您提出的要求对不足之处作出相应的改正。
作出.pinyin: Wǒ men huì gēn jù nín tí chū de yāo qiú duì bù zú zhī chǔ zuò chū xiāng yìng de gǎi zhèng
作出.en: We will follow your demands and make the necessary corrections to those parts that need them.

想起来.pinyin: Xiàn zài wǒ xiǎng qi lai le

想起来.zh: 我一听到那首歌，就想起来我小的时候。
想起来.pinyin: Wǒ yī tīng dào nà shǒu gē jiù xiǎng qi lai wǒ xiǎo de shí hou
想起来.en: When I heard that song, it reminded me of when I was a kid.

想起来.zh: 我才想起来我之前该买个面包。

想起来.zh: 哦，我才想起来，身份证不要忘了带。

想起来.en: Oh, I just remembered, do not forget to bring your ID.

战胜.pinyin: Wǒ men zhàn shèng le dí rén

战胜.zh: 我们必须团结起来才能战胜敌人。
战胜.pinyin: Wǒ men bì xū tuán jié qǐ lai cái néng zhàn shèng dí rén
战胜.en: We need to band together to beat the enemy.

战胜.pinyin: Zuì dà de shèng lì shì zhàn shèng zì jǐ

梅纳德.zh: 梅纳德的焦虑感涌了上来。

梅纳德.en: Mennad couldn't go to the toilet by himself.

置疑.zh: 他无庸置疑是个伟大的艺术家。
置疑.pinyin: Tā wú yōng zhì yí shì gè wěi dà de yì shù jiā
置疑.en: It is clear that he is a great artist.
置疑.es: Está claro que él es un gran artista.

置疑.zh: 毋庸置疑，汤姆毒害了玛丽。
置疑.pinyin: Wú yōng zhì yí tāng mǔ dú hài le mǎ lì
置疑.en: There's no doubt that Tom poisoned Mary.
置疑.es: No hay duda de que Tom envenenó a Mary.

一月.zh: 一月是一年之中的头一个月。
一月.pinyin: Yī yuè shì yī nián zhī zhōng de tóu yī gè yuè
一月.en: January is the first month of the year.
一月.es: Enero es el primer mes del año.

一月.zh: 一月通常是最冷的月份。
一月.pinyin: Yī yuè tōng cháng shì zuì lěng de yuè fèn
一月.en: January is usually the coldest month.
一月.es: Enero usualmente es el mes más frío.

一月.zh: 他的书仅仅一月前出版了，且已经卖了一千册。
一月.pinyin: Tā de shū jǐn jǐn yī yuè qián chū bǎn le qiě yǐ jīng mài le yī qiān cè
一月.en: His book was published just one month ago, and it has already sold thousands of copies.
一月.es: Su libro fue publicado hace solo un mes y ya vendió miles de copias.

一月.pinyin: Yī yuè zǒng huì zài zhè lǐ xià xuě

恒星.zh: 离我们太阳系最近的恒星是比邻星。
恒星.pinyin: Lí wǒ men tài yáng xì zuì jìn de héng xīng shì bǐ lín xīng
恒星.en: The nearest star to our solar system is Proxima Centauri.
恒星.es: La estrella más cercana a nuestro sistema solar es Próxima Centauri.

恒星.zh: 汤姆不懂恒星和行星的区别。
恒星.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bù dǒng héng xīng hé xíng xīng de qū bié
恒星.en: Tom doesn't know the difference between a star and a planet.
恒星.es: Tom no sabe la diferencia entre una estrella y un planeta.

恒星.zh: 地球不是恒星，而是行星。
恒星.pinyin: Dì qiú bù shì héng xīng ér shì xíng xīng
恒星.en: The earth is not a star, but a planet.
恒星.es: La tierra no es una estrella sino un planeta.

恒星.zh: 天文学涉及恒星和行星。
恒星.pinyin: Tiān wén xué shè jí héng xīng hé xíng xīng
恒星.en: Astronomy deals with the stars and planets.
恒星.es: La astronomía trata de estrellas y planetas.

高楼.zh: 我家的旁边建了一栋高楼。
高楼.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de páng biān jiàn le yī dòng gāo lóu
高楼.en: A tall building was built next to my house.
高楼.es: Un edificio alto fue construido al lado de mi casa.

高楼.pinyin: Nà shi zhuàng gāo lóu bù shì ma
高楼.en: That is a high building, is it not?

高楼.pinyin: Kàn nà bian nà zhuàng gāo lóu
高楼.en: Look at the large building over there.

困扰.zh: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。
困扰.pinyin: Zāo shòu xīn zàng bìng kùn rǎo de rén shù zēng jiā le
困扰.en: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
困扰.es: El número de personas sufriendo de problemas cardíacos ha aumentado.

困扰.zh: 他正遭受严重头痛的困扰。
困扰.pinyin: Tā zhèng zāo shòu yán zhòng tóu tòng de kùn rǎo
困扰.en: He was suffering from a bad headache.
困扰.es: Él estaba sufriendo de un terrible dolor de cabeza.

困扰.zh: 你如果遭受老鼠困扰，可以使用超音波来吓跑它们。
困扰.pinyin: Nǐ rú guǒ zāo shòu lǎo shǔ kùn rǎo kě yǐ shǐ yòng chāo yīn bō lái xià pǎo tā men
困扰.en: If you have rat or mouse problems, you can scare them off with ultrasound.
困扰.es: Si tiene problemas de ratas o ratones, puede espantarlos con ultrasonido.

困扰.zh: 许多欧洲的大都市饱受“甜甜圈现象”困扰。
困扰.pinyin: Xǔ duō ōu zhōu de dà dū shì bǎo shòu tián tián quān xiàn xiàng kùn rǎo
困扰.en: Many of Europe's metropolises are plagued by the doughnut phenomenon.

生命危险.zh: 他冒著生命危险救了我的命。
生命危险.pinyin: Tā mào zhe shēng mìng wēi xiǎn jiù le wǒ de mìng
生命危险.en: He saved my life at the risk of his own.
生命危险.es: Él me salvó la vida arriesgando la suya.

生命危险.zh: 你在说我有生命危险吗？
生命危险.pinyin: Nǐ zài shuō wǒ yǒu shēng mìng wēi xiǎn ma
生命危险.en: Are you saying my life is in danger?
生命危险.es: ¿Me estás diciendo que mi vida está en peligro?

生命危险.zh: 他冒著生命危险救了他的朋友。
生命危险.pinyin: Tā mào zhe shēng mìng wēi xiǎn jiù le tā de péng you
生命危险.en: He saved his friend at the risk of his own life.
生命危险.es: Él salvó a su amigo arriesgando su propia vida.

生命危险.zh: 他冒着生命危险救了那条狗。
生命危险.pinyin: Tā mào zhe shēng mìng wēi xiǎn jiù le nà tiáo gǒu
生命危险.en: He rescued the dog at the risk of his own life.
生命危险.es: Él salvó al perro arriesgando su propia vida.

走运.zh: 你真走运，因为他没咬你。
走运.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn zǒu yùn yīn wèi tā méi yǎo nǐ
走运.en: You're lucky because he didn't bite you.
走运.es: Has tenido suerte de que no te haya mordido.

走运.pinyin: Tā zhǎo gōng zuò bù zǒu yùn
走运.en: He had no luck in finding work.
走运.es: No tuvo suerte para encontrar trabajo.

走运.pinyin: Nǐ men sān gè hěn zǒu yùn
走运.en: All three of you are very lucky.

走运.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shí hou zhēn zǒu yùn

邮箱.pinyin: Zhè lǐ fù jìn yǒu méi yǒu yóu xiāng
邮箱.en: Is there a mailbox near here?
邮箱.es: ¿Hay un buzón de correos cerca de aquí?

邮箱.zh: 告诉我汤姆的邮箱地址吧。

邮箱.zh: 你的邮箱为什么发不过去邮件呢，奇怪。

邮箱.en: Strange, why can't I send any mail to your mail box?

出事.zh: 即使您的声音颤抖，也要说出事实。
出事.pinyin: Jí shǐ nín de shēng yīn chàn dǒu yě yào shuō chū shì shí
出事.en: Speak the truth, even if your voice shakes.
出事.es: Di la verdad aunque te tiemble la voz.

出事.zh: 我妹妹出事之后，我爸爸和我照顾她直到康复。
出事.pinyin: Wǒ mèi mei chū shì zhī hòu wǒ bà ba hé wǒ zhào gu tā zhí dào kāng fù
出事.en: My father and I nursed my sister back to health after her accident.

出事.zh: 我们总是应该带上安全带以防出事故。
出事.pinyin: Wǒ men zǒng shì yīng gāi dài shàng ān quán dài yǐ fáng chū shì gù
出事.en: We should always wear a seatbelt in case we have an accident.

返回.zh: 汤姆星期一来的，第二天返回了。
返回.pinyin: Tāng mǔ xīng qī yī lái de dì èr tiān fǎn huí le
返回.en: Tom came on Monday and went back the day after.
返回.es: Tom vino el lunes y volvió a su casa al día siguiente.

返回.pinyin: Yī ge xiǎo shí hòu tā fǎn huí le
返回.en: She came back an hour later.

返回.zh: 他总有一天要返回日本。
返回.pinyin: Tā zǒng yǒu yī tiān yào fǎn huí rì běn
返回.en: One day he will return to Japan.
返回.es: Un día él regresará a Japón.

返回.zh: 当迈克返回到简的家的时候，她睡得正熟。
返回.pinyin: Dāng mài kè fǎn huí dào jiǎn de jiā de shí hou tā shuì de zhèng shú
返回.en: When Mike returned to Jane's house, she was sleeping.

暴风.en: The storm prevented us from arriving on time.

暴风.zh: 一棵大树在暴风中倒下。

暴风.en: A big tree fell in the storm.
暴风.es: Un gran árbol cayó en la tormenta.

暴风.pinyin: Bào fēng guò hòu shì níng jìng
暴风.en: After a storm comes a calm.
暴风.es: Después de la tormenta viene la calma.

暴风.zh: 播种风, 就收获暴风。
